fields.FIR_Description: During the morning of 2026-05-16, around 07:00, Harish Selvam, aged 30, could not be traced after leaving home for a temple visit; the last sighting was near Nallur Puram Market Road, according to the complaint recorded on 2026-05-19. The complaint was lodged by Tamilarasan Palanisamy (9000000023), a family member of Harish Selvam, whose last active mobile number is noted as 9000000205. No independent witness was identified at the time of registration. Hariharan Subramani (9000000044), described as a person who arranged the contact, was also mentioned in the complaint. The complainant could not identify the person involved. Potentially relevant material referenced includes photographs.
fields.Modus_Operandi: Person reportedly left the residence and could not be contacted afterwards.
fields.Keywords: missing person, adult, associate, photograph, market road, morning
